title: PanTact: Teaching Whole-Body Dexterity with a Wearable Contact Interface
description:
arXiv:2610.12558v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humanoid robots have many degrees of freedom and contact surfaces, yet most loco-manipulation research restricts manipulation to the hands and avoids other body contacts with the environment. To extend manipulation beyond the hands, we present PanTact, a system that learns humanoid whole-body dexterity, the capability to manipulate with any suitable body surface, directly from robot-free human demonstrations.
